title: Grasp Execution Without a Planner: Configuration-Space Grasp Distance Fields with Certified Safety & Guaranteed Quality
summary: Standard multifingered grasp execution architectures plan a collision-free trajectory to a selected grasp pose and track it with a feedback law. Execution-time object pose uncertainty or perturbations may invalidate the planned trajectory, forcing a costly replanning step. We present Grasp Distance Fields (GDFs), a smooth softmin distance field over grasp configurations in the arm-hand configuration space. Our controller executes a grasp by following this field's negative gradient with a stationary feedback law, eliminating the need for a planner, stored trajectory, or grasp selection. For safety, we filter this command through a CBF-CLF quadratic program (QP) constraining self-collision, workspace, object, and obstacle clearance, reporting impeded progress as explicit slack. We prove that the softmin tracks the true set distance within \(\log N/ρ\) for \(N\) candidates and smoothing parameter \(ρ\), and that the filtered loop renders the safe set forward invariant. Since no smooth field captures hand-object contact switching, we switch modes with hysteresis at a pregrasp configuration, trading object collision avoidance for contact admission. A wrench-quality barrier then keeps the realized grasp's force-closure margin within a prescribed tolerance of its value at hold onset. We evaluate in kinematic simulation on a fixed-base arm and a Unitree G1 humanoid, both fitted with the same underactuated hand. Our controller navigates cluttered and dynamic scenes to safely reach for, grasp, and lift 46 of 50 objects spanning primitive, household, and adversarial classes. Across those lifts, the executed grasps retain a median 94\% of their synthesized quality margin, at 0.09 ms QP solve time per 20 ms control step. Per-step softmax weights confirm that our controller executes the nearest candidate, obviating a separate selection step. Project page: www.clintonenwerem.com/gdf.
tldr: This paper presents Grasp Distance Fields (GDFs), a novel controller that uses a smooth distance field over grasps to execute grasping without a planner or trajectory, with certified safety via CBF-CLF QP and guaranteed quality via a force-closure barrier.
tldr_zh: 本文提出抓取距离场(GDFs)，通过光滑距离场实现无需规划器的抓取执行，利用CBF-CLF二次规划保证安全性，并通过力闭合屏障保证抓取质量。
summary_zh: 标准多指抓取执行架构会规划一条从当前位置到选定抓取姿态的无碰撞轨迹，并通过反馈律进行跟踪。执行过程中物体位姿的不确定性或扰动可能导致预定轨迹失效，从而需要代价高昂的重新规划步骤。我们提出抓取距离场（Grasp Distance Fields, GDFs），即在手臂-手部联合构型空间中，针对抓取构型构建的一种光滑软最小距离场。我们的控制器通过稳态反馈律沿着该场的负梯度方向执行抓取，消除了对规划器、存储轨迹或抓取选择的需求。为保障安全，我们通过一个带有控制障碍函数（CBF）与控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）的二次规划（QP）对该指令进行滤波，约束自碰撞、工作空间、物体与障碍物间距，并将受阻进度以显式松弛变量的形式报告。我们证明，对于\(N\)个候选构型与平滑参数\(ρ\)，软最小值在\(\log N/ρ\)的误差范围内逼近真实集合距离，且滤波后的闭环系统使安全集保持前向不变性。由于光滑场无法捕捉手-物体接触模式的切换，我们在预抓取构型处采用滞回方式切换模式，将物体避障转化为接触接纳。随后通过一个力封闭质量势垒，使实际抓取的力封闭裕度保持在抓取起始时刻规定容忍范围内。我们在固定基座机械臂和宇树G1人形机器人（两者均配备相同的欠驱动手）上进行了运动学仿真评估。在涵盖原始物体、家用物体及对抗性物体类别的50个物体中，我们的控制器能在杂乱与动态场景中安全地抓取并举起其中46个物体。在这些举起过程中，实际抓取保持了其中位数94%的综合质量裕度，每个20毫秒控制步长内QP求解时间为0.09毫秒。每步的软最大权重证实我们的控制器执行的是最近候选抓取构型，无需单独的选择步骤。项目页面：www.clintonenwerem.com/gdf。

title: DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World-Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation
summary: Dynamic manipulation requires robots to infer target motion and respond promptly, yet existing World-Action Models (WAMs) typically condition only on the current frame and execute large backbones synchronously, limiting motion awareness and responsive control in dynamic scenes. We propose DynamicWAM, a compact WAM for dynamic object manipulation with dual-path motion conditioning. DynamicWAM introduces history-flow conditioning, encoding temporally aligned optical-flow frames alongside the current observation through a frozen pretrained video VAE to preserve spatial motion structure, while injecting kinematic descriptors of displacement, duration, velocity, and acceleration into the action expert to provide motion magnitude and timing. The two complementary paths are fused through joint world-action attention. A distilled compact backbone and real-time chunking (RTC)-based asynchronous execution further enable responsive control. On DOMINO, DynamicWAM achieves a 38.2% success rate and a 53.2 manipulation score, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Across 12 real-world tasks spanning linear, circular, and compound target motion, it achieves a 46.7% average success rate, exceeding the strongest baseline by 22.9 percentage points.
tldr: DynamicWAM introduces dual-path motion conditioning (history-flow encoding and kinematic descriptors) with a compact backbone and asynchronous execution to enable responsive dynamic object manipulation, achieving significant improvements over baselines.
tldr_zh: DynamicWAM 通过双路径运动条件（历史流编码和运动学描述符）结合紧凑骨干网络与异步执行，实现了对动态物体的响应式操控，性能显著优于基线。
summary_zh: 动态操控要求机器人推断目标运动并快速响应，然而现有的世界-动作模型（WAMs）通常仅依赖当前帧进行处理，并同步执行庞大的骨干网络，这限制了机器人在动态场景中的运动感知与响应控制能力。为此，我们提出DynamicWAM——一种面向动态物体操控的紧凑型WAM，采用双路径运动条件机制。该模型引入历史流条件编码：通过冻结的预训练视频变分自编码器，将时间对齐的光流帧与当前观测帧共同编码，以保留空间运动结构；同时将位移、持续时间、速度与加速度等运动学描述符注入动作专家模块，以提供运动幅度与时机信息。两条互补路径通过联合世界-动作注意力机制进行融合。此外，采用蒸馏紧凑型骨干网络与基于实时分块（RTC）的异步执行机制，实现响应式控制。在DOMINO基准测试中，DynamicWAM取得了38.2%的成功率与53.2的操作评分，超越所有参评基线模型。在涵盖直线、圆周及复合目标运动的12项真实世界任务中，其平均成功率达46.7%，较最强基线模型高出22.9个百分点。

title: SIPTraj: Map-Free End-to-End Trajectory Prediction via Physics-Guided Scene Interaction
summary: Trajectory prediction of surrounding agents is a prerequisite for safe planning and decision making in autonomous driving. Without high-definition (HD) maps, sensor-derived bird's-eye-view (BEV) features provide no explicit lane topology or drivable-area priors, making it inherently difficult to ground each agent in its surrounding scene context. Moreover, physical feasibility remains difficult to capture through data-driven learning alone, as kinematic constraints on agent motion cannot be explicitly encoded without structured supervision. Existing map-free predictors extract scene context in an agent-agnostic manner through a single fusion step and treat physical constraints only as output-level penalties, leaving both challenges unaddressed. We propose SIPTraj, a map-free trajectory prediction framework that jointly addresses scene grounding and physical feasibility. SIPTraj introduces a Hierarchical Agent-Scene Encoder (HASE) progressively grounding each agent in agent-guided scene evidence and refining inter-agent relations within the scene-grounded space. To tackle physical infeasibility in predicted trajectories, we develop a Physics-Guided Iterative Decoder (PGID). It conditions decoding on instantaneous kinematic states, propagating physical supervision into internal representations rather than output trajectories alone. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 Sensor show that SIPTraj surpasses prior map-free predictors and strong map-based baselines without any HD map at inference. Our code will be released as open-source.
tldr: SIPTraj proposes a map-free trajectory prediction framework for autonomous driving that uses a hierarchical agent-scene encoder for better scene grounding and a physics-guided iterative decoder to enforce kinematic feasibility.
tldr_zh: SIPTraj 提出了一种无地图的自动驾驶轨迹预测框架，通过层级式智能体-场景编码器增强场景关联，并利用物理引导的迭代解码器保证运动学可行性。
summary_zh: 周围智能体的轨迹预测是自动驾驶中安全规划与决策的前提条件。在没有高精地图的情况下，由传感器生成的鸟瞰图特征无法提供明确的车道拓扑或可行驶区域先验信息，这使得将每个智能体锚定到其周围场景上下文中本质上面临困难。此外，仅通过数据驱动学习难以捕捉物理可行性，因为智能体运动的运动学约束无法在缺乏结构化监督的情况下被显式编码。现有的无地图预测方法通过单一融合步骤以智能体无关的方式提取场景上下文，并将物理约束仅作为输出层惩罚项处理，导致这两个挑战均未得到解决。我们提出SIPTraj，一种无地图轨迹预测框架，联合处理场景锚定与物理可行性问题。SIPTraj引入分层智能体-场景编码器，通过智能体引导的场景证据逐步锚定每个智能体，并在场景锚定空间中细化智能体间关系。为解决预测轨迹的物理不可行性，我们开发了物理引导迭代解码器。它将解码过程基于瞬时运动学状态进行条件约束，将物理监督传播至内部表征而不仅是输出轨迹。在nuScenes与Argoverse 2 Sensor数据集上的大量实验表明，SIPTraj在推理时不依赖任何高精地图，性能超越了先前的无地图预测方法以及基于地图的强基线模型。我们的代码将作为开源项目发布。

title: SelfWAM: A Self-Grounded Unified World Action Model for Fast Robot Control
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling actions and future observations. However, conditioning future prediction only on the task prompt and observation context risks capturing generic task progression rather than the action-specific consequences of the executed action. We introduce SelfWAM, a unified self-grounded WAM built on a modality-specialized Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture that jointly predicts actions, action-conditioned future RGB frames, and robot self-masks, thereby grounding future prediction in the robot's visible body and its action-induced motion. During joint training, SelfWAM allows future visual queries to attend to a clean copy of the demonstrated action, turning the video branch into an action-specific consequence model while leaving the fast action-only inference path unchanged. To focus video learning on action-relevant visual changes, we use prompt-specific objectives for future robot self-mask prediction, which removes appearance details and provides a target whose temporal evolution is tightly coupled with the conditioning action. Together, clean-action conditioning and future self-mask supervision make future predictions more directly reflect how the executed action changes the robot's visible motion and the surrounding scene. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks show that SelfWAM produces more action-sensitive futures and preserves fast policy inference, while improving policy performance.
tldr: SelfWAM introduces a self-grounded World Action Model that jointly predicts actions, future RGB frames, and robot self-masks using a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, improving action-conditioned future prediction and policy performance in real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: SelfWAM 提出了一种自接地世界动作模型，通过混合变换器架构联合预测动作、未来 RGB 帧和机器人自掩码，改进了动作条件未来预测并提升了真实世界操作任务的策略性能。
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）通过联合建模行动与未来观测来提升机器人策略学习能力。然而，仅靠任务提示和观测上下文来预测未来，存在将通用任务进程误认为所执行行动之特定后果的风险。我们提出SelfWAM——一种建立在模态专业化混合专家Transformer（MoT）架构上的统一自基础WAM，它能联合预测行动、基于行动的彩色未来帧与机器人自掩膜，从而将未来预测建立在机器人可见身体及其行动引发的运动之上。在联合训练中，SelfWAM允许未来视觉查询关注演示行动的干净副本，将视频分支转化为行动特定后果模型，同时保持仅基于行动的快速推理路径不变。为聚焦视频学习于行动相关的视觉变化，我们采用提示特定的目标函数进行未来机器人自掩膜预测，该目标会消除外观细节并提供与条件行动时间演化紧密耦合的预测目标。通过干净行动条件与未来自掩膜监督的协同作用，未来预测能更直接地反映执行行动如何改变机器人可见运动及周围场景。在RoboTwin 2.0与真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，SelfWAM能生成对行动更敏感的未来预测，保持快速策略推理能力，同时提升策略性能。

title: Staged Multi-Agent Training (SMAT) for Hip Exoskeletons: Metabolic and Biomechanical Validation of a Simulation-Trained Co-Adaptive Controller
summary: Learning-based controllers can deliver exoskeleton assistance after training entirely in physics-based simulation, yet few controllers that address human-device co-adaptation have been validated on real users by whole-body metabolic measurement, the standard benchmark for assistive walking. Co-adaptation is challenging: as the device alters joint dynamics, the wearer reorganizes neuromuscular coordination, producing a non-stationary learning problem. Staged Multi-Agent Training (SMAT), a four-stage curriculum that progressively trains a musculoskeletal human actor and a bilateral hip exoskeleton actor, was introduced and shown to reduce simulated hip-muscle activation and provide positive assistance on hardware. This article provides the first physiological validation of SMAT. The policy was deployed on a hip exoskeleton and tested with eight healthy adults, with metabolic cost measured by indirect calorimetry across no-exoskeleton, passive, and active conditions. Active assistance lowered net metabolic rate by 19.7% relative to the passive device (p < 0.001). Biomechanical analysis confirmed predominantly positive hip mechanical power across all subjects (positive-power ratio 0.98), and the policy generalized across walking speeds and terrains. Together, these results show that a single simulation-trained SMAT policy, deployed without subject-specific retraining, delivers a significant metabolic benefit on real users while remaining robust beyond the conditions it was trained on.
tldr: This paper validates a simulation-trained co-adaptive controller (SMAT) on real hip exoskeletons, showing a 19.7% net metabolic reduction in human subjects and robust generalization across speeds and terrains.
tldr_zh: 本文验证了仿真训练的人机协同自适应控制器（SMAT）在实际髋关节外骨骼上的效果，结果表明受试者净代谢率降低19.7%，并在多种速度和地形上具有鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 基于学习的控制器可在完全基于物理仿真的训练后提供外骨骼辅助，但针对人机协同适应问题的控制器极少通过全身代谢测量（行走辅助的标准评估方法）在真实用户中得到验证。协同适应具有挑战性：当装置改变关节动力学特性时，穿戴者会重新组织神经肌肉协调，形成非平稳学习问题。本文引入的分阶段多智能体训练（SMAT）通过四阶段课程逐步训练肌肉骨骼人体智能体与双侧髋关节外骨骼智能体，已被证明能够降低模拟髋部肌肉激活水平，并在硬件上提供正向辅助。本研究首次对SMAT进行生理学验证。该策略部署于髋关节外骨骼，对八名健康成年人开展测试，通过间接测热法测量无外骨骼、被动模式与主动模式下的代谢成本。相较于被动装置，主动辅助使净代谢率降低19.7%（p < 0.001）。生物力学分析证实所有受试者的髋关节机械功率均为正向（正向功率比0.98），且该策略可泛化至不同步行速度与地形。综合结果表明，单个经过仿真训练的SMAT策略在无需针对个体重新训练的情况下，能为真实用户带来显著代谢效益，且在训练条件之外仍保持鲁棒性。

title: FlowPilot: Real-Time World-Action Modeling for Agile UAV Navigation
summary: We present FlowPilot, a compact world-action model for real-time onboard UAV navigation from depth. Unlike map-then-optimize pipelines that require local reconstruction or end-to-end policies that lack explicit scene prediction, FlowPilot jointly denoises future depth observations and executable trajectories with flow matching. A dual-stream mixture-of-transformers couples video and action experts through shared attention, allowing future-scene prediction and trajectory generation to inform each other. At deployment, the model runs action-centrically and outputs only a trajectory. To ensure trackability, actions are parameterized as degree-7 Bernstein polynomials: the current state constrains the initial control points, and the network predicts five free control points, yielding C^2-continuous references with closed-form velocity, acceleration and jerk. FlowPilot is trained on a three-level depth pyramid spanning high-throughput simulation, photorealistic simulation, and real onboard data. In closed-loop simulation, it outperforms learning- and optimization-based baselines under increasing clutter and commanded speeds up to 8m/s. On a physical quadrotor, the full perception-to-action pipeline runs in under 18ms on a Jetson Orin NX and reaches 5.5m/s in cluttered indoor and forest environments using only onboard sensing and computation.
tldr: FlowPilot introduces a compact world-action model that jointly denoises future depth observations and executable trajectories using flow matching, enabling real-time agile UAV navigation on resource-constrained onboard hardware.
tldr_zh: FlowPilot 提出了一种紧凑的世界-动作模型，通过流匹配联合去噪未来深度观测和可执行轨迹，在资源受限的机载硬件上实现实时敏捷无人机导航。
summary_zh: 我们提出FlowPilot，一种用于基于深度信息的实时机载无人机导航的紧凑型世界-动作模型。与需要局部重建的"建图-优化"流水线或缺乏显式场景预测的端到端策略不同，FlowPilot通过流匹配联合去噪未来的深度观测结果与可执行轨迹。一种双流混合专家变换器通过共享注意力机制耦合视频与动作专家，使得未来场景预测与轨迹生成能够相互促进。在实际部署中，该模型以动作为中心运行，仅输出轨迹。为确保可跟踪性，动作被参数化为七次伯恩斯坦多项式：当前状态约束初始控制点，网络预测五个自由控制点，从而生成具有闭合形式速度、加速度与加加速度的C²连续参考轨迹。FlowPilot基于涵盖高通量仿真、逼真仿真与真实机载数据的三级深度金字塔进行训练。在闭环仿真中，它在 clutter 逐渐增多且指令速度高达8米/秒的情况下，性能优于基于学习与优化的基线方法。在物理四旋翼平台上，完整的感知-动作流水线在Jetson Orin NX上运行时间低于18毫秒，仅依靠机载传感与计算即可在杂乱室内及森林环境中达到5.5米/秒的速度。

title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
summary: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies on mobile robots creates a systems conflict: semantic reasoning benefits from cloud GPUs, whereas closed-loop control must respond locally despite network delay and jitter. Existing hierarchical and asynchronous policies improve throughput, but their slow-path representations can still arrive stale or require explicit scheduling and delay cues. We introduce CloudEdgeVLA, a cloud-edge policy that treats temporal misalignment as a representation-learning problem. A cloud VLA encodes delayed observations into slowly varying task features, while a lightweight edge head combines the latest available cloud feature with current local vision. During training, current and randomly delayed frames are paired with the same current action target in fresh and stale paths. This objective encourages the cloud representation to preserve task-level information while the edge path supplies state-sensitive corrections. Across four LIBERO suites, CloudEdgeVLA retains 63.8--78.0% success with a 40-step uniform-delay window, whereas VLASH reaches at most 6.4% and the evaluated single-path baselines at most 3.0%. By removing blocking synchronization from the control loop, the design offers a practical route to scalable VLA deployment in which cloud models can grow while edge computation remains lightweight and responsive.
tldr: CloudEdgeVLA introduces a representation-learning approach to handle cloud-edge latency in VLA robot policies by encouraging cloud features to remain stable under delay while a lightweight edge head supplies real-time state corrections, achieving robust performance under up to 40-step delays.
tldr_zh: CloudEdgeVLA 提出了一种表征学习方法，通过使云端特征在延迟下保持稳定，同时轻量级边缘端提供实时状态修正，从而处理 VLA 机器人策略中的云边延迟问题，在高达 40 步延迟下仍保持鲁棒性能。
summary_zh: 在移动机器人上部署十亿级参数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略会引发系统冲突：语义推理依赖云端GPU，而闭环控制必须应对网络延迟和抖动在本地实时响应。现有分层和异步策略虽能提升吞吐量，但其慢路径表示仍可能滞后到达，或需要显式调度及延迟提示。我们提出CloudEdgeVLA——一种将时间错位视为表示学习问题的云边协同策略。云端VLA将延迟观测编码为缓变的任务特征，而轻量级边缘头部则将最新可用的云端特征与当前本地视觉信息相融合。训练阶段，当前帧与随机延迟帧分别通过新鲜路径与陈旧路径配对同一当前动作目标。该目标鼓励云端表示保留任务级信息，同时边缘路径提供状态敏感的修正。在四个LIBERO测试套件中，CloudEdgeVLA在40步均匀延迟窗口下仍保持63.8%–78.0%的成功率，而VLASH最高仅达6.4%，评估的基线单路径模型最高仅达3.0%。通过消除控制环路中的阻塞同步，该设计为可扩展的VLA部署提供了实用路径——云端模型可持续扩展，而边缘计算仍保持轻量与响应及时。

title: DexMani: Human-Derived Manipulability Guidance for Dexterous Rotation
summary: Dexterous object rotation is a sequential contact problem: each support, release, and re-contact decision must both produce the desired object motion, and prepare the hand configuration for continued rotation. Existing reinforcement learning methods discover such movement patterns through trial and error on specific robotic hand embodiments, without explicitly accounting for how each contact transition affects the hand's ability to sustain object rotation in subsequent steps. We introduce DexMani, a framework that transfers human demonstrations as contact-conditioned manipulability evolution. This prior captures how successful human contact transitions reshape the object-rotation directions available to the hand. DexMani then learns this manipulability evolution and uses it to guide downstream reinforcement learning, enabling rotation skills to be acquired across robot embodiments with distinct kinematics and active-contact configurations. Across the Shadow Hand, Allegro Hand, and XHand, DexMani achieves the highest success rates in every evaluated setting for both seen and unseen objects. DexMani reaches an average success rate of 57.5% on LEAP Hand, outperforming other baselines and producing smoother rotatory motions. Project site: https://dexmani.github.io
tldr: DexMani transfers human demonstrations as contact-conditioned manipulability evolution to guide reinforcement learning for dexterous object rotation, achieving high success rates across multiple robot hand embodiments.
tldr_zh: DexMani 将人类演示转化为接触条件可操作性演化，以指导强化学习进行灵巧物体旋转，在多种机器人手上实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 灵巧物体旋转是一个连续接触问题：每一次支撑、释放和重新接触的决策，既要产生所需的物体运动，又要为持续旋转准备好手部构型。现有的强化学习方法通过在特定机器人手部实体上的试错来发现此类运动模式，但未明确考虑每次接触转换如何影响手部在后续步骤中维持物体旋转的能力。我们提出了DexMani框架，该框架将人类演示转化为以接触为条件的可操作性演化先验。这一先验捕捉了成功的人类接触转换如何重塑手部可实现的物体旋转方向。随后，DexMani学习这种可操作性演化，并利用其指导下游的强化学习，从而使得旋转技能能够在具有不同运动学结构和主动接触配置的机器人实体上被习得。在Shadow Hand、Allegro Hand和XHand上，DexMani在所有评估场景中，无论是针对已见过还是未见过物体，均取得了最高成功率。在LEAP Hand上，DexMani达到了57.5%的平均成功率，超越了其他基线方法，并产生了更平滑的旋转运动。项目网站：https://dexmani.github.io

title: SSTG-Nav: Metric-Grounded Spatial-Semantic Topological Graphs for Reusable Object Navigation
summary: Service robots operating for months in the same homes, offices, and facilities should become more reliable with experience instead of searching familiar space from scratch for every request. Yet ObjectNav is predominantly formulated as one-shot exploration, leaving a central deployment challenge unresolved: recognizing an object does not identify a reachable place to stop, and one confident map error can terminate the task. We introduce SSTG-Nav, a reusable metric-semantic memory that turns a one-time survey into actionable object goals, consolidates evidence across viewpoints, and retains spatially distinct recovery standoffs. On 1,000 HM3D-v2 episodes across 36 scenes, our goal-independent topology achieves a 99.4% geometric success ceiling. Holding semantic responses fixed, metric grounding raises SR/SPL from 0.835/0.560 to 0.920/0.603, and source-aware fusion reaches 0.926/0.586. Fusion-aware Top-3 recovery raises Success@1/2/3 to 0.928/0.965/0.975 and reaches 0.601 SPL@3. Model, field-of-view, density, and corruption controls identify where these gains originate, and a ROS2/Nav2 realization demonstrates the complete reusable query-to-execution pipeline. Together, the results establish pre-exploration as a powerful practical regime for dependable, repeated semantic navigation.
tldr: SSTG-Nav introduces a reusable metric-semantic topological memory for object navigation, enabling robots to leverage prior exploration to achieve high success rates on repeated tasks without searching from scratch.
tldr_zh: SSTG-Nav 提出了一种可复用的度量-语义拓扑记忆用于物体导航，使机器人能够利用先前的探索经验，在重复任务中无需从头搜索即可实现高成功率。
summary_zh: 服务机器人在同一家庭、办公室和设施中运行数月后，应能凭借经验变得更可靠，而非每次接到指令都从头搜索熟悉的空间。然而，目标导航（ObjectNav）主要被设定为一次性探索任务，这留下了一个关键的部署难题：识别出物体并不等同于找到一个可到达的停靠位置，而且一个错误的地图置信度判断就可能导致任务终止。我们提出了SSTG-Nav，一种可复用的度量-语义记忆系统，它将一次性环境勘测转化为可执行的目标点，整合多视角下的证据，并保留具有空间区分度的恢复备用位点。在横跨36个场景的1000次HM3D-v2测试序列中，我们的目标无关拓扑结构实现了99.4%的几何成功率上限。在固定语义响应的情况下，度量接地将SR/SPL从0.835/0.560提升至0.920/0.603，而源感知融合则达到了0.926/0.586。融合感知的Top-3恢复策略将Success@1/2/3提升至0.928/0.965/0.975，并达到0.601的SPL@3。通过模型、视场角、密度和噪声干扰控制实验，我们明确了这些性能提升的来源，而基于ROS2/Nav2的实现则展示了从查询到执行的完整可复用流程。这些结果共同确立了预探索作为实现可靠、重复语义导航的一种强大实用范式。

title: First Deployable Dynamic-CoM: A Unified Policy and Method-Agnostic Benchmark for Humanoid Single-Leg Balance
summary: Unified humanoid policies handle agile whole-body motion, yet stumble on a simple demand: staying balanced on one leg. On our single-leg-balance benchmark, eight released state-of-the-art general policies hold a clean single-leg stance on 0 of 90 test motions; they stay up only by stepping or hopping, recovering from imbalance rather than preventing it. Prevention needs the capture point (xCoM), the center of mass (CoM) extrapolated by its velocity, which has never driven a hardware policy because it requires a base linear velocity no on-board sensor provides; expressed relative to the support foot, that velocity cancels exactly, leaving an observation reconstructible from encoders and IMU alone. We put this first deployable dynamic-CoM observation directly into the actor that runs on hardware, and pair it with a reward library translated term by term from human postural control, under one principle: prevention over repair. Trained by asymmetric FastSAC with a privileged critic and no distillation, the resulting policy, FDDC (First Deployable Dynamic-CoM), holds clean single-leg balance on 86 of 90 held-out motions across nine stratified pose classes and transfers to a real Unitree G1; in ablation, the dynamic-CoM observation is the single largest driver: removing it alone costs 40 points of clean single-leg balance. We release the full stack with the first method-agnostic, reproducible sim2sim benchmark for humanoid single-leg balance, scoring each policy in a simulator distinct from its training one, a step toward turning balance from a per-task trick into a capability the field can measure.
tldr: This paper introduces the first deployable dynamic-CoM observation for humanoid single-leg balance, enabling a policy trained with asymmetric FastSAC to achieve high success on unseen motions and transfer to a real robot, along with a method-agnostic benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个可部署的动态质心观测量用于人形机器人单腿平衡，结合非对称FastSAC训练的策略在未见动作上取得高成功率并迁移到真实机器人，同时发布了一个方法无关的基准。
summary_zh: 统一人形策略能够处理敏捷的全身运动，却在一个简单需求上栽跟头：单腿保持平衡。在我们的单腿平衡基准测试中，八种已发布的最先进通用策略在90个测试动作中无一能保持稳定的单腿站立姿态；它们只能通过迈步或跳跃来维持平衡，即通过恢复失衡状态而非预防失衡发生。预防失衡需要捕捉点（xCoM），即由质心速度外推得到的质心位置，该参数此前从未用于驱动硬件策略，因为它需要基础线性速度，而任何机载传感器均无法提供此数据；若以支撑脚为参考系表达，该速度项恰好抵消，仅留下可通过编码器和惯性测量单元重建的观测值。我们首次将这种可部署的动态质心观测值直接输入到硬件运行的智能体中，并配合逐项源自人类姿态控制的奖励库，遵循"预防优于修复"的核心原则。通过非对称FastSAC算法结合特权评论家进行训练（无需知识蒸馏），最终生成的策略FDDC（首个可部署动态质心）在涵盖九个分层姿态类别的90个保留测试动作中，成功在86个动作上实现稳定的单腿平衡，并成功迁移到真实的宇树G1机器人上。消融实验表明，动态质心观测值是唯一最重要的驱动因素：仅移除该观测值就导致单腿平衡成功率下降40个百分点。我们开源了完整工具链，包含首个与训练方法无关、可复现的人形单腿平衡仿真-仿真基准测试，在独立于训练环境的模拟器中评估各项策略，这标志着将平衡能力从特定任务技巧转变为该领域可量化的基础能力迈出了关键一步。

title: The Gate, Not the Cache: Gate Provenance Bounds the Closed-Loop Reliability of Training-Free VLA Token Skipping
summary: Token skipping is a widely used training-free way to accelerate vision--language--action (VLA) models by bypassing computation for most visual tokens at each control step according to a gate. When the next gate is harvested from the previous accelerated forward, however, the tokens skipped at one step are also the ones least visible to the next gate, and the damage can compound across control steps until the task fails. We study the two mechanisms this class is built on, reuse and deletion, crossing each against where its gate signal comes from on identical episodes. At a skip ratio of 0.9 on LIBERO-Object, both collapse when the gate comes from the model's own accelerated forwards, to 0.68 under reuse and to 0.31 under deletion against a dense 1.00, and the collapse is invisible to the action-level detectors we evaluate. What separates collapse from dense-level operation is not the mechanism but whether the gate is clean, computed by a forward that skipped nothing. We therefore propose actuation-slack refresh, one dense pass run while the robot executes its current action chunk, off the critical path, that hands the next step a clean gate and a fresh KV base. Since the measured detectors do not reliably reveal the failure, the refresh is unconditional rather than triggered. Both mechanisms then recover to 0.98, keeping the speed of skipping and the information of a dense pass. We then integrate the refresh into state-of-the-art caching and pruning methods across two VLA policies, 4 LIBERO suites, and 4 SIMPLER tasks, where it repairs every collapse caused by using a self-harvested gate. Serve latency drops 18--22\% below dense, measured both in simulation and on a physical robot. Where the gate signal comes from, not how tokens are skipped, decides closed-loop reliability for accelerated VLAs.
tldr: This paper investigates the closed-loop reliability of training-free token skipping in VLA models, showing that failure arises not from the skipping mechanism but from using a self-harvested gate; it proposes actuation-slack refresh to restore performance while maintaining acceleration.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了VLA模型中免训练令牌跳跃的闭环可靠性，表明失败源于使用自获取的门而非跳跃机制本身；并提出了执行间隙刷新以在保持加速的同时恢复性能。
summary_zh: 跳跃式Token处理是一种广泛使用的免训练加速方法，通过门控机制在每个控制步骤中跳过大多数视觉Token的计算，从而加速视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。然而，当从上一轮加速前向传播中获取下一轮门控信号时，被跳过的Token也正是下一轮门控信号最难以感知的部分，这种损伤会在连续控制步骤中累积放大，最终导致任务失败。我们研究了此类方法依赖的两种机制——复用与删除，并在相同情节下交叉对比这两种机制中门控信号的来源。在LIBERO-Object数据集中，当跳过比例为0.9时，若门控信号来自模型自身的加速前向传播，两种机制均出现性能崩溃：复用机制从密集计算的1.00降至0.68，删除机制则降至0.31，而我们评估的动作级检测器无法捕捉到这种崩溃。区分崩溃与密集计算层级性能的关键并非机制本身，而在于门控信号是否"干净"——即是否由无跳过的前向传播计算得出。为此，我们提出"动作松弛刷新"方法：在机器人执行当前动作块的同时，在关键路径之外执行一次密集前向传播，为下一控制步骤提供干净的门控信号与全新的KV缓存。由于现有检测器无法可靠预警故障，该刷新策略采用无条件执行而非触发式执行。两种机制在采用该策略后性能均恢复至0.98，既保持了跳过的速度优势，又保留了密集前向传播的信息完整性。我们进一步将该刷新方法集成到当前最先进的缓存与剪枝方法中，在两种VLA策略、4个LIBERO测试集和4个SIMPLER任务上进行了验证，有效修复了所有因使用自获取门控信号导致的性能崩溃。仿真与实体机器人实验均表明，服务延迟相比密集计算降低18%-22%。决定加速VLA闭环可靠性的关键并非Token的跳过方式，而是门控信号的来源。

title: Action Chunk Scheduling for Batched Robot Policy Serving
summary: Deploying robot foundation models at scale is the next step towards realizing the potential of general-purpose robots. However, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and other foundation models are computationally demanding, and on-device compute is constrained by power and space. In this paper, we introduce the problem of serving a robot policy to multiple robots from a remote GPU and formulate it as a scheduling problem. We build Armory, a serving system validated on fleets of both simulated and real robots. Our experiments show that naive scheduling heuristics perform well when all robots are the same, but fall short when robots consume action chunks at different rates, uncovering a mismatch between conventional batching methods and the closed-loop requirements of robot policy execution. To address this, we propose a scheduling algorithm that accounts for this heterogeneity and improves overall system throughput by up to $18\%$ in real-world experiments. Additional details are available at https://gatech-rl2.github.io/actionchunkscheduling.
tldr: This paper introduces Armory, a serving system that batches robot policy inference from remote GPUs for multiple robots, and proposes a scheduling algorithm to handle heterogeneous action chunk consumption rates, improving throughput by up to 18% on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Armory，一个为多机器人远程GPU批量处理策略推理的服务器系统，并设计了一种调度算法应对异构动作块消费速率，在真实机器人上实现了高达18%的吞吐量提升。
summary_zh: 大规模部署机器人基础模型是实现通用机器人潜力的下一步。然而，视觉-语言-动作模型及其他基础模型对计算资源需求极高，而设备端计算能力受限于功耗与空间。本文提出从远程GPU向多台机器人提供机器人策略服务的问题，并将其形式化为调度问题。我们构建了Armory系统——一个在模拟及真实机器人集群上验证的服务系统。实验表明：当所有机器人配置相同时，朴素调度启发式算法表现良好；但当机器人以不同速率消耗动作块时，这些算法便显露出局限性，揭示了传统批处理方法与机器人策略执行闭环需求之间的失配。为解决该问题，我们提出一种能适应这种异质性的调度算法，在实际实验中可将系统整体吞吐量提升高达18%。更多详情请访问 https://gatech-rl2.github.io/actionchunkscheduling。

title: Towards General Language-Conditioned Latent Safety Filters
summary: Robot policies are becoming increasingly general, with vision-language-action (VLA) models enabling a single policy to execute diverse tasks specified in natural language. Safe deployment, however, requires adapting not only to new tasks but also to varying safety requirements across users, environments, and applications. Existing safety filters remain largely constraint-specific and thus must be redesigned or relearned when safety requirements change. In this paper, we investigate language-conditioned safety filtering, in which a Hamilton-Jacobi safety actor and critic are conditioned on language-specified constraints. We evaluate this formulation across pick-and-place, table-wiping, and block-stacking tasks in the vision-based setting, examining its ability to enforce language-specified constraints and transfer to unseen constraint instances within the evaluated constraint families. Our experiments provide evidence that language-conditioned safety filters reduce constraint violations and exhibit partial transfer to unseen constraint instances.
tldr: This paper introduces language-conditioned safety filters using Hamilton-Jacobi reachability to enforce varying safety constraints on VLA robot policies, showing reduced violations and partial transfer to unseen constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出基于语言条件的安全滤波器，利用Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析来满足VLA机器人策略中多样化的安全约束，实验表明能减少违规行为并部分泛化到未见约束。
summary_zh: 机器人策略正日益通用化，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使单一策略能够执行自然语言指定的多样化任务。然而，安全部署不仅需要适应新任务，还需适应不同用户、环境及应用场景中变化的安全需求。现有安全过滤器大多局限于特定约束条件，因此当安全需求改变时必须重新设计或重新学习。本文研究语言条件化的安全过滤方法，其中哈密顿-雅可比安全执行器与评判器基于语言指定的约束条件进行条件化处理。我们在基于视觉的拾放、擦桌与堆叠任务中评估该框架，检验其执行语言指定约束的能力，以及在评估的约束族内迁移至未见约束实例的效果。实验证据表明，语言条件化安全过滤器可减少违反约束的情况，并展现出对未见约束实例的部分迁移能力。

title: Latent-Centroid Steering: Single-Pass Classifier-Free Guidance for Command-Aligned Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving, enabling agents to map multimodal inputs and high-level navigation instructions directly to executable trajectories. However, in practice, these models exhibit a persistent command-following gap: predicted trajectories often show weak sensitivity to navigation commands, resulting in incorrect behavior at critical decision points. We identify this issue as a form of conditional policy collapse, where regression-based training under multimodal trajectory distributions encourages the model to rely on dominant visual priors while marginalizing the language-conditioned signal. To address this issue, we introduce a principled formulation of classifier-free guidance (CFG) for regression-based vision-language driving. We show that CFG can be interpreted as isolating the instruction-induced residual in the action space by contrasting conditional and unconditional predictions, thereby explicitly amplifying the effect of the navigation command at inference time. However, a standard two-pass CFG introduces prohibitive latency for real-time control and produces noisy instance-level guidance directions. Building on a mean-shift interpretation of CFG, we propose Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS), a single-pass guidance mechanism that replaces instance-level residuals with class-level latent shifts. By projecting conditional representations toward precomputed command-specific centroids, LCS performs class-level latent steering based on cluster geometry that is both more stable and computationally efficient. We demonstrate that LCS reduces inference latency by approximately 50% while achieving stronger command adherence and improved driving performance on both closed-loop (Bench2Drive) and open-loop (nuScenes) benchmarks. Code will be released.
tldr: Proposes Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS), a single-pass classifier-free guidance method for vision-language autonomous driving that reduces latency by 50% while improving command adherence and driving performance on closed-loop and open-loop benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出潜在质心引导（LCS），一种用于视觉语言自动驾驶的单遍无分类器引导方法，在降低50%延迟的同时，在闭环和开环基准测试中提升了命令遵循度和驾驶性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）近期已成为端到端自动驾驶领域一种前景广阔的范式，使智能体能够将多模态输入和高层级导航指令直接映射为可执行的轨迹。然而在实践中，这些模型存在持续的指令跟随偏差：预测的轨迹通常对导航指令的敏感性较弱，导致在关键决策点出现错误行为。我们将此问题识别为一种条件策略坍缩形式——在多模态轨迹分布下的基于回归训练会促使模型依赖主导性视觉先验，同时边缘化语言条件信号。为解决此问题，我们针对基于回归的视觉-语言驾驶任务，提出了一种无分类器引导（CFG）的规范化公式。研究表明，CFG可通过对比条件预测与无条件预测，在动作空间中分离出指令引发的残差，从而在推理时显式增强导航指令的效果。然而，标准的双通道CFG会为实时控制带来不可接受的延迟，并产生噪声较大的实例级引导方向。基于CFG的均值漂移解释，我们提出了一种子穿越质心引导（LCS）方法，这是一种用类别级潜在偏移替代实例级残差的单通道引导机制。通过将条件表征投影至预计算的指令专属质心，LCS基于聚类几何结构执行类别级潜在引导，该方法既更稳定又计算高效。实验证明，LCS在将推理延迟降低约50%的同时，在闭环（Bench2Drive）和开环（nuScenes）基准测试中均实现了更强的指令遵循能力和更优的驾驶性能。相关代码将公开。

title: Developing Combined Manipulation and Locomotion Skills with Interaction Representation and Skill Composition
summary:
This paper addresses how to enable a humanoid robot to learn motion policies based on developmental principles and combine policies to create more sophisticated and useful behaviors. Specifically, we present an approach to (1) learning a whole-body reaching and grasping policy and (2) combining it and a standing-up and walking policy to compose a more complex policy of manipulation and locomotion: grasping, standing up, and walking.
  In (1), our method draws inspiration from harmonic analysis and adopts cubic harmonics as weights to represent the hand-object spatial relationship via spatial convolution. Utilizing an intra-episode finger joint decoupling curriculum based on developmental principles, a robot can autonomously learn a generalizable grasping policy without relying on external datasets or pretrained models.
  In (2), our method combines the grasping policy with a separately learned getting-up policy by providing both policies with their respective observation vectors and using hand-object interaction scores to determine when each policy should control which robot joints. Our results show a 93% zero-shot success rate for grasping unseen objects and a 96-100% success rate for standing up while holding the object. Our work also demonstrates that combining different policies is only effective if each policy learning happens on the same whole humanoid body even if a policy (such as for locomotion) does not seem to need all the body parts (such as fingers).
tldr: This paper proposes a developmental approach for humanoid robots to learn a whole-body reaching and grasping policy using cubic harmonics for interaction representation, and combines it with a standing-up and walking policy to achieve complex manipulation and locomotion behaviors with high zero-shot success.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于发展原理的人形机器人学习方法，利用三次谐波作为交互表示学习全身抓取策略，并将其与起立行走策略组合，实现高成功率的零样本操作与移动复合行为。
summary_zh:
本文探讨如何基于发展原理使人形机器人学习运动策略，并通过组合策略生成更复杂、更实用的行为。具体而言，我们提出一种方法：（1）学习全身抓取与拿取策略，（2）将其与站起及行走策略相结合，从而构建包含操作与移动的更复杂策略：抓取、站起和行走。

在（1）中，我们的方法受谐波分析启发，采用三次谐波作为权重，通过空间卷积表征手部与物体的空间关系。利用基于发展原理的帧内手指关节解耦课程，机器人能够自主习得具有泛化能力的抓取策略，无需依赖外部数据集或预训练模型。

在（2）中，我们的方法通过为抓取策略与单独习得的站立策略分别提供各自的观测向量，并利用手-物交互得分判定各策略何时控制机器人的哪些关节，从而实现两种策略的组合。实验结果表明：对未见物体的零样本抓取成功率达93%，持物站立成功率达96-100%。本工作同时表明：只有当各策略在同一完整人形躯体框架下进行学习时（即便某些策略（如移动策略）看似无需使用所有身体部位（如手指）），策略组合方能有效。

title: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
summary: Stochastic world models are usually evaluated by the accuracy and calibration of their predicted futures. These criteria leave a decision-relevant ambiguity: the same conditional future distribution can arise because an observation aliases different physical states, or because the dynamics remain random after the declared full state is fixed. We prove that this attribution is not identifiable from ordinary transition data, even with an optimal probabilistic predictor. We introduce ClosurePairs, an interventional evaluation protocol that crosses compatible microstates with repeated exogenous disturbances. A two-way variance decomposition identifies state aliasing, process noise, and their nonlinear interaction; an independent-repeat variant applies when disturbances cannot be reused. On likelihood-equivalent Gaussian systems, paired supervision reduces alias-fraction error 15.96-fold at identical test NLL. Across 18 nonlinear Langevin conditions, it reduces attribution MAE from 0.372 to 0.051 and sensing regret from 0.0138 to 0.0003 without changing NLL. On a pixel-conditioned recurrent model, a frozen shared-state probe reduces alias-fraction MAE against a deep ensemble from 0.584 to 0.130 in distribution and from 0.630 to 0.170 out of distribution over ten seeds. Finally, in a matched-total-variance REFINE/BRANCH test, a total-variance router reaches 66.48 percent plus or minus 1.06 percent accuracy, whereas ClosurePairs reaches 99.99 percent plus or minus 0.02 percent and improves selected NLL from -2.087 to -2.717 over five seeds. ClosurePairs therefore measures why futures branch, information that proper forecast scores cannot identify.
tldr: This paper proposes an interventional evaluation protocol, ClosurePairs, to distinguish whether stochasticity in world model predictions arises from state aliasing or inherent process noise, a distinction that standard forecast metrics cannot identify.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种干预性评估协议 ClosurePairs，用于区分世界模型预测中的随机性是源于状态混淆还是固有的过程噪声，而标准的预测指标无法识别这一区别。
summary_zh: 随机世界模型通常通过其预测结果的准确性与校准度进行评估。这些标准存在决策相关歧义：相同的条件未来分布可能源于观测结果混叠了不同物理状态，亦或是在已声明完整状态确定后动力学仍存在随机性。我们证明，即使采用最优概率预测器，这种归因也无法通过常规转移数据识别。我们提出闭包对（ClosurePairs）这一介入式评估协议，通过将兼容微观态与重复外生扰动交叉匹配，利用双向方差分解识别状态混叠、过程噪声及其非线性交互作用，并针对扰动不可重复场景提出独立重复变体。在似然等价的高斯系统中，配对监督在相同测试负对数似然（NLL）下将混叠分数误差降低15.96倍；在18种非线性朗之万条件下，该方法在保持NLL不变时将归因平均绝对误差从0.372降至0.051，感知遗憾值从0.0138降至0.0003。在像素条件循环模型中，冻结共享状态探针将混叠分数平均绝对误差（相对于深度集成模型）在分布内从0.584降至0.130，在分布外（十次随机种子）从0.630降至0.170。最后，在匹配总方差的REFINE/BRANCH测试中，总方差路由器的准确率为66.48%±1.06%，而闭包对达到99.99%±0.02%，并在五次随机种子中将选定NLL从-2.087提升至-2.717。因此，闭包对能够测量未来分支的成因，而这一信息是传统预测评分指标无法识别的。

title: WM-Cov: Test Adequacy for Interactive World-Model-Style Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: World models and generative simulators are emerging as interactive testing infrastructure for autonomous driving because they can react to the ego planner and produce counterfactual, rare, and safety-critical rollouts. This changes a test scenario from a fixed replayed trajectory into an interactive scenario family whose realized evolution depends on the planner under test. The unresolved question is therefore not only whether dangerous rollouts can be generated, but what valid closed-loop evidence is enough to support a specified testing intent and stopping decision. This paper formulates interactive world-model-style testing adequacy and introduces WM-Cov, a provider-agnostic evaluation layer that converts raw provider outputs into requested, realized, and valid evidence. WM-Cov reports adequacy through coverage growth, valid-failure discovery, failure-mode diversity, realism, artifact suppression, duplicate accounting, and valid-evidence precision. Studies on executed TeraSim/SUMO events, WM-like mixed trace pools, and a real DriveArena TrafficManager--WorldDreamer matrix show that dangerous-looking events can include valid ADS failures, duplicates, partial realizations, and artifacts. The DriveArena matrix evaluates two planners, two horizons, six prompt conditions, and 360 ego-route requests; 304 attempts become fully realized evidence and 56 remain partial. A disjoint 80-request route-slice check yields 74 fully realized and 6 partial attempts. The results support evaluating world-model-style testing by convergence of valid interactive evidence under budget, rather than by raw generated failures or prompt coverage alone.
tldr: This paper formulates test adequacy for interactive world-model-style autonomous driving simulation and introduces WM-Cov, a provider-agnostic evaluation layer that converts raw provider outputs into valid evidence for closed-loop testing.
tldr_zh: 本文为交互式世界模型风格的自动驾驶仿真提出了测试充分性概念，并引入了WM-Cov，一个供应商无关的评估层，将原始供应商输出转化为闭环测试的有效证据。
summary_zh: 世界模型与生成式模拟器正作为自动驾驶的交互式测试基础设施而兴起，因为它们能够响应自我规划器并生成反事实、罕见及安全关键的展开场景。这将测试场景从固定的回放轨迹转变为交互式场景族，其实际演化取决于被测试的规划器。因此，未解决的关键问题不仅在于能否生成危险展开场景，更在于何种有效的闭环证据足以支持特定的测试意图和停止决策。本文对交互式世界模型风格的测试充分性进行了形式化定义，并引入WM-Cov——一种与提供者无关的评估层，可将原始提供者输出转化为请求证据、实现证据与有效证据。WM-Cov通过覆盖率增长、有效失效发现、失效模式多样性、真实性、伪影抑制、重复计数及有效证据精度来报告充分性。对已执行的TeraSim/SUMO事件、类WM混合轨迹池及真实DriveArena TrafficManager--WorldDreamer矩阵的研究表明：看似危险的事件可能包含有效ADS失效、重复事件、部分实现及伪影。DriveArena矩阵评估了两个规划器、两种时间跨度、六种提示条件及360条自车路线请求；其中304次尝试成为完全实现证据，56次为部分实现。通过分离的80条路线切片检查，得到74个完全实现与6个部分实现尝试。研究结果表明：应基于预算限制下有效交互证据的收敛性来评估世界模型风格测试，而非仅依赖原始生成的失效或提示覆盖率。

title: ORCESTRA: VLM-driven Visual Robot programming in Mixed Reality
summary: ORCESTRA is a mixed-reality system for programming robot digital twins through no-code waypoint teaching and language-guided control. In a passthrough mixed-reality workspace, users place robot twins on real surfaces, teach trajectories, save robot-relative episodes, or issue spoken/typed commands that a vision-language model converts into structured digital-twin plans. Both interaction modes share a backend for metric grounding, embodiment-aware validation, preview, confirmation, and digital-twin execution. The system supports heterogeneous robot embodiments, including fixed-base manipulators, a mobile base, and a humanoid robot, demonstrating MR validation as a safety layer for language-guided robot programming before physical deployment.
tldr: ORCESTRA presents a mixed-reality system that uses a vision-language model to convert no-code waypoint teaching and spoken/typed commands into structured plans for robot digital twins, supporting multiple embodiments as a safety-validation layer before physical deployment.
tldr_zh: ORCESTRA 提出了一种混合现实系统，利用视觉语言模型将无代码路径点教学和语音/文本指令转换为结构化数字孪生计划，支持多种机器人形态，在物理部署前提供安全验证。
summary_zh: ORCESTRA是一种混合现实系统，通过无代码航点示教与语言引导控制实现机器人数字孪生的编程。在穿透式混合现实工作空间中，用户可将机器人孪生体放置在真实表面上，进行轨迹示教、保存机器人相关片段，或通过语音/文字输入指令，由视觉语言模型将其转换为结构化的数字孪生方案。两种交互模式共享同一后端，支持度量锚定、具身感知验证、预览、确认及数字孪生执行。该系统支持异构机器人形态，包括固定基座机械臂、移动底座及人形机器人，验证了混合现实可作为语言引导机器人编程在物理部署前的安全层。

title: Push-Wiper: Toward General-Purpose Robotic Cleaning across Varied Stains and Surfaces with Segmented Pushing Trajectories
summary: Viscous stains, characterized by high viscosity and complex rheological properties, remain a major challenge for robotic surface cleaning. Conventional wiping often spreads the stain, while scrubbing provides stronger friction but risks damaging the surface. In this paper, we propose Push-Wiper, a framework that reformulates viscous stain cleaning as an aggregation problem. Push-Wiper employs a sponge to progressively gather stains through segmented pushing trajectories, followed by a post-processing phase that detaches the aggregated material and enables sponge self-cleaning. We adopt a stepwise strategy for stain gathering and leverage Diffusion Policy to generate adaptive pushing action sequences. These sequences are executed through our Arbitrary Surface Pose Interpolator (ASPI) and a hybrid force-position controller, allowing the method to generalize to stains with diverse spatial distributions. Push-Wiper achieves a cleaning score (CS), defined as the percentage of stain area removed, up to 130% higher than baseline methods. Without additional training, Push-Wiper also transfers in a zero-shot manner to solid residues, liquid spills, unseen viscous stains, and curved surfaces with varying geometries. Our experiments demonstrate the cleaning effectiveness of Push-Wiper and its strong generalization ability. The project website is available at https://push-wiper.github.io/.
tldr: Push-Wiper reformulates robotic cleaning of viscous stains as an aggregation problem using segmented pushing trajectories guided by Diffusion Policy, achieving significantly higher cleaning scores and zero-shot generalization to various stains and surfaces.
tldr_zh: Push-Wiper 将粘性污渍的机器人清洁重新定义为聚集问题，通过扩散策略引导的分段推挤轨迹，实现了显著更高的清洁分数以及对多种污渍和表面的零样本泛化。
summary_zh: 高粘度且具备复杂流变特性的粘性污渍，仍是机器人表面清洁领域的主要挑战。传统擦拭方式容易导致污渍扩散，而刷洗虽能提供更强摩擦力却存在损伤表面的风险。本文提出Push-Wiper框架，将粘性污渍清洁重新定义为聚合问题。该框架通过分段推挤轨迹使用海绵逐步聚集污渍，随后后处理阶段分离聚合物质并实现海绵自清洁。我们采用渐进式污渍收集策略，并利用扩散策略生成自适应推挤动作序列。通过自主研制的任意表面位姿插补器（ASPI）与混合力位控制器执行这些序列，使该方法能泛化至具有不同空间分布的污渍。Push-Wiper的清洁评分（定义为污渍面积清除百分比）较基线方法最高提升130%。无需额外训练，该框架即可零样本迁移至固体残留物、液体溢出物、未知粘性污渍及不同几何曲率的曲面场景。实验证明Push-Wiper的清洁有效性及其强泛化能力。项目网站详见https://push-wiper.github.io/。

title: From Failures to Supervision: DynamicEnvPlan for Robust Long-Horizon Embodied Planning
summary: Physical-world interaction is inherently dynamic, as environments can evolve during execution, requiring agents to adapt their plans under non-stationary conditions. We study this challenge through long-horizon embodied planning under environment deviations and execution uncertainty. Existing embodied-task benchmarks can expose such failures, but these failures are usually treated as evaluation outcomes instead of learnable signals for training agents to recover. In this work, we introduce DynamicEnvPlan, a closed-loop framework for high-level planning in dynamic environments. It extends embodied task execution with humanoid agents, high-level primitive skills, structured semantic memory, and controllable perturbations. Our data synthesis design consists of planning, perturbation, and guarded correction modules that turn dynamic execution states into recovery-oriented traces. The resulting traces are used for staged supervised fine-tuning, enabling the planner to learn from both nominal execution and perturbed recovery trajectories. Using 104 task-scene combinations spanning i.i.d., compositional generalization, and out-of-distribution settings for fine-tuning and evaluation, DynamicEnvPlan boosts success rate from 33.3% for the base planner to 76.2%, while improving across all seven evaluation metrics critical to physical-world interaction, including safety and affordance compliance.
tldr: DynamicEnvPlan is a closed-loop framework for robust long-horizon embodied planning in dynamic environments, using perturbation and recovery traces to supervise fine-tuning of a high-level planner, achieving large success-rate gains on 104 task-scene combinations.
tldr_zh: DynamicEnvPlan 是一个用于动态环境中鲁棒长程具身规划的闭环框架，通过扰动与恢复轨迹监督微调高层规划器，在104个任务-场景组合上大幅提升成功率。
summary_zh: 物理世界中的交互本质上具有动态性，因为环境可能在执行过程中发生变化，要求智能体在非平稳条件下调整其计划。我们通过环境偏差与执行不确定性下的长时域具身规划来研究这一挑战。现有具身任务基准可以暴露此类失败，但这些失败通常被视为评估结果，而非用于训练智能体进行恢复的可学习信号。在本工作中，我们提出DynamicEnvPlan——一个面向动态环境高层规划的闭环框架。该框架通过类人智能体、高层原始技能、结构化语义记忆及可控扰动扩展了具身任务执行。我们的数据合成设计包含规划、扰动与防护性校正模块，可将动态执行状态转化为面向恢复的轨迹。这些轨迹被用于分阶段监督微调，使规划器能够同时从标称执行轨迹与扰动恢复轨迹中学习。通过覆盖独立同分布、组合泛化及分布外场景的104种任务-场景组合进行微调与评估，DynamicEnvPlan将基线规划器的成功率从33.3%提升至76.2%，同时在所有七项物理世界交互关键评估指标（包括安全性与可供性合规性）上均实现改进。

title: Disentangling Visuo-Tactile Foresight: Oracle-Guided Interface Discovery for World Action Models
summary: Contact-rich manipulation remains challenging because successful control depends on physical interaction cues that are often weakly observable from vision alone. Recent tactile world action models jointly model future visual observations and tactile signals to guide action generation, but how such futures should be structured for effective use by the action expert remains underexplored. Directly studying this question with learned world action models is difficult because end-to-end behavior entangles physically invalid visual futures, unreliable predictions, inaccurate or cross-modally inconsistent tactile forecasts, and an unreadable future-to-action interface. To make this interface independently studyable, we introduce Oracle Visuo-Tactile Foresight (OVTF), a controlled framework that supplies paired RGB and tactile futures from successful trajectories verified in simulation. By fixing the future provider, OVTF isolates the interface and asks a cleaner question: if the future is successful and physically executable, what representation allows the action expert to absorb its benefit? Within OVTF, we propose Asymmetric Phase-Local Future Memory (AFM), in which visual memory reads future vision, each tactile memory jointly attends to its own tactile stream and phase-aligned future vision, and cross-tactile access is blocked. We compare AFM with Modality-Isolated Future Memory (IFM), which removes visual-to-tactile access and processes each future modality independently. Across seven tasks on the UniVTAC simulation benchmark, AFM achieves 32.0% average success, compared with 23.7% for IFM and 14.9% for UniVTAC-ACT. This controlled comparison shows that selective phase-aligned visual-tactile routing provides a more actionable future-to-action bridge than complete modality isolation.
tldr: The paper introduces Oracle Visuo-Tactile Foresight (OVTF), a controlled framework to study how future vision and tactile signals should be structured for effective robot action policies, and proposes Asymmetric Phase-Local Future Memory (AFM) which achieves higher success rates on contact-rich manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Oracle Visuo-Tactile Foresight (OVTF)，一个用于研究未来视觉和触觉信号应如何结构以有效指导机器人动作策略的受控框架，并提出了非对称相位局部未来记忆 (AFM)，在接触丰富的操作任务上取得了更高的成功率。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作任务仍具挑战性，因为成功控制依赖于物理交互线索，而这些线索往往仅凭视觉难以充分观测。近期提出的触觉世界动作模型通过联合建模未来视觉观测与触觉信号来引导动作生成，但此类未来信息应如何构建以被动作专家有效利用，这一机制尚未充分探索。直接借助学习型世界动作模型研究该问题存在困难，因为端到端行为会混淆物理无效的未来视觉、不可靠的预测、不准确或跨模态不一致的触觉预测，以及难以解读的未来到动作接口。为使该接口可独立研究，我们提出"神谕视觉触觉预见"（OVTF）框架——该受控框架从仿真中验证成功的轨迹中提供配对的RGB与触觉未来信息。通过固定未来信息提供源，OVTF将接口分离，提出更清晰的问题：若未来信息是成功的且物理可执行，何种表示能让动作专家吸收其益处？在OVTF框架内，我们提出"非对称相位对齐局部未来记忆"（AFM），其中视觉记忆读取未来视觉，每个触觉记忆同时关注自身触觉流及相位对齐的未来视觉，且跨触觉通道的访问被阻断。我们将AFM与"模态隔离未来记忆"（IFM）进行对比——后者移除视觉到触觉的访问，独立处理各未来模态。在UniVTAC仿真基准的七项任务中，AFM平均成功率达32.0%，而IFM与UniVTAC-ACT分别为23.7%与14.9%。该受控对比表明，选择性相位对齐的视觉-触觉路由比完全模态隔离能提供更具可操作性的未来到动作桥梁。

title: Learning to Predict Contact Force Distributions from Vision Leveraging Object Geometry Priors
summary: Based on vision and prior experience, humans can make rough physical predictions and adjust their manipulation strategies. This paper aims to endow robots with a similar ability. To collect paired data of vision and forces, we use a rigid-body simulator commonly adopted in robotics. However, unlike simulators that output noisy point forces, humans are able to make consistent predictions even in unfamiliar situations. Based on this observation, we hypothesize that predicting smooth force distributions rather than raw point forces can improve both force prediction itself and downstream task performance. To validate this hypothesis, we construct a model that predicts three-dimensional force distributions from a single RGB image of piled daily objects. The target distribution is generated by applying statistical smoothing to point forces obtained from the simulator. Moreover, by incorporating object geometry into the smoothing process, we aim to account for variations in contact states and achieve more consistent vision-based predictions. We conduct extensive evaluations in both simulation and real environments. Results show that our approach improves prediction accuracy, enhances downstream task performance through smoothing, and further benefits from geometry-guided smoothing. Remarkably, the trained model generalizes effectively to real-world scenes despite being trained solely in simulation.
tldr: This paper presents a model that predicts smooth 3D force distributions from a single RGB image of piled objects, using a simulator with geometry-guided smoothing to improve accuracy and enable sim-to-real transfer for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从单张RGB图像预测散乱物体三维力分布的方法，利用物理仿真与几何引导平滑提升预测精度，并实现从仿真到真实场景的泛化。
summary_zh: 基于视觉与先验经验，人类能够做出粗略的物理预测并调整其操作策略。本文旨在赋予机器人类似的能力。为收集视觉与力的配对数据，我们采用了机器人领域常用的刚体仿真器。然而，与输出含噪点力的仿真器不同，人类即使在陌生情境中也能做出一致的预测。基于这一观察，我们假设预测平滑的力分布而非原始点力，既能提升力预测本身的准确性，也能改善后续任务的表现。为验证该假设，我们构建了一个模型，该模型能够从单张堆叠日用品的RGB图像中预测三维力分布。目标分布通过对仿真器获取的点力施加统计平滑生成。此外，通过将物体几何信息融入平滑过程，我们旨在考虑接触状态的变化，从而实现更一致的基于视觉的预测。我们在仿真与真实环境中开展了大量评估。结果表明，我们的方法提高了预测精度，通过平滑增强了后续任务性能，并进一步受益于几何引导的平滑。值得注意的是，尽管模型仅在仿真环境中训练，它却能有效泛化至真实场景。

title: Hybrid Attention Estimation Pipeline for Adaptive HRI Using an Expressive Robotic Head
summary: This paper presents an applied case study on hybrid visual attention estimation for human-robot interaction using an expressive robotic head based on the InMoov ecosystem. The proposed pipeline combines a fast geometric perception layer with an independent semantic perception layer based on a vision-language model. The geometric layer provides high-frequency face and head-pose information for temporal regulation, while the semantic layer receives only raw egocentric camera frames and produces contextual attention labels related to attention toward the robot, phone use, or attention elsewhere. These signals are integrated through a finite state machine that regulates adaptive interaction behavior, including activation, waiting, interaction resumption, and return to rest. The system was evaluated with 10 participants across 40 trials covering baseline and adaptive interaction conditions. Results show reliable interaction start across all trials, consistent pause behavior in the adaptive distraction condition, and non-redundant semantic information between the geometric and semantic outputs.
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid visual attention estimation pipeline that combines geometric and semantic layers for adaptive human-robot interaction using an expressive robotic head, evaluated in a user study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合视觉注意力估计管道，结合几何层和语义层，用于具有表现力的机器人头部的自适应人机交互，并通过用户研究进行了评估。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一项应用案例研究，探讨基于InMoov生态系统表情机器人头部的混合视觉注意力估计方法，用于人机交互。所提出的流程将快速几何感知层与基于视觉语言模型的独立语义感知层相结合。几何层提供高频面部与头部姿态信息以进行时间调控，而语义层仅接收原始自我中心摄像头帧，并生成与对机器人注意力、手机使用或注意力分散相关的上下文注意力标签。这些信号通过有限状态机进行整合，以调控自适应交互行为，包括激活、等待、交互恢复及回归静止状态。该系统在40次试验中与10名参与者进行了评估，涵盖基线条件与自适应交互条件。结果显示，所有试验中交互启动均可靠；在自适应分心条件下，暂停行为表现一致；且几何输出与语义输出之间具有非冗余的语义信息。

title: Compliant Sphere Lattice Contact: Distributed Contact Modeling for Sphere-Based Robot Representations
summary: Contact planning in robotics requires models that are both computationally efficient and physically accurate. Sphere-based robot representations satisfy the first requirement by enabling fast collision checking and differentiable geometry, but sacrifice physical accuracy by relying on point contact which cannot capture contact patch area, pressure distributions, rotational stiffness, or frictional moments. We introduce Compliant Sphere Lattice Contact (CSLC), a distributed contact model that operates natively on sphere representations by modeling the robot interface as a compliant lattice of surface spheres connected through anchor and lateral springs. When pressed against an object, the lattice deforms to produce a spatially distributed contact patch that improves the physical accuracy of sphere-based contact. We validate CSLC across two independent solvers and show preliminary results demonstrating contact patch formation and improved grasp stability.
tldr: CSLC introduces a distributed contact model for sphere-based robot representations, using a compliant lattice of surface spheres to capture contact patch area, pressure distribution, and rotational stiffness, improving physical accuracy for contact planning and grasp stability.
tldr_zh: CSLC 提出了一种用于球体机器人表示的分布式接触模型，通过表面球体的柔性晶格变形来捕捉接触斑面积、压力分布和旋转刚度，从而提升接触规划和抓取稳定性的物理精度。
summary_zh: 机器人接触规划需要兼具计算效率与物理精度的模型。基于球体的机器人表征通过快速碰撞检测与可微几何满足前一项要求，但依赖点接触牺牲了物理精度——无法捕捉接触区域面积、压力分布、旋转刚度或摩擦力矩。我们提出柔性球体点阵接触（CSLC），一种本机运行于球体表征的分布式接触模型。该模型通过锚固弹簧与横向弹簧连接表面球体构成柔性点阵，以表征机器人界面。当压向物体时，点阵发生形变产生空间分布的接触区域，从而提升基于球体的接触模型的物理精度。我们在两个独立求解器上验证CSLC，初步结果表明其能形成接触区域并提升抓取稳定性。

title: Motion Planning for Mobile Manipulators Navigating Doorways via Model Predictive Control
summary: Navigating doorways is a fundamental capability for mobile manipulators operating in human environments, requiring coordinated motion between the mobile base and manipulator arm. This paper presents a motion planning framework that generates dynamically feasible and collision-free trajectories for autonomously opening and traversing both push and pull doors. The proposed method formulates the robot and door as a coupled dynamical system within a nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC) optimization framework. Manipulation feasibility is enforced through a penalty-based constraint, avoiding explicit arm kinematic modeling in the planner. Simulations and a hardware experiment demonstrate that the approach successfully plans feasible trajectories for door traversal.
tldr: This paper presents a Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for mobile manipulators to navigate doorways, treating the robot and door as a coupled dynamical system, and validates it in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）的移动操作机器人通过门道的运动规划框架，将机器人与门视为耦合动力学系统，并在仿真和硬件实验中验证了可行性。
summary_zh: 摘要：在人类环境中运行的移动操作机器人，穿越门洞是一项基础能力，需要移动基座与机械臂之间的协调运动。本文提出了一种运动规划框架，能够为自动开启并穿越推拉门生成动态可行且无碰撞的轨迹。该方法将机器人与门建模为非线性模型预测控制（MPC）优化框架内的耦合动力系统。通过基于惩罚项的约束来确保操作可行性，避免了在规划器中显式建立机械臂运动学模型。仿真与硬件实验表明，该方法能够成功规划出穿越门洞的可行轨迹。

title: Learning-Based Motion Planning for Dynamic Environments: From Foundational Algorithms to Emerging Paradigms
summary: Motion planning in dynamic environments is a fundamental problem in robotics, aiming to generate safe and efficient paths, trajectories, or control actions in the presence of moving obstacles, uncertain predictions, and multi-agent interactions. It has broad applications in autonomous driving, service robotics, warehouse logistics, human-robot collaboration, crowd navigation, and multi-robot systems. This survey reviews representative works published primarily between 2015 and 2025, with a particular focus on how recent learning-based advances extend, complement, or interact with classical planning foundations. We first revisit classical planning methods as algorithmic foundations and reference frameworks for learning-based extensions. We then propose a role-of-learning taxonomy that categorizes existing methods according to how learning participates in the planning pipeline, including direct policy learning, learning-augmented classical planning, hybrid planning, and training enhancement methods. For each category, we summarize the main problem settings, representative algorithms, key ideas, integration mechanisms, strengths, and limitations. We further analyze how observation representations, prediction uncertainty, interaction modeling, planner integration, safety constraints, and training strategies shape learning-based motion planning in dynamic environments. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions, including sim-to-real gap, safe and certifiable planning, dense crowd navigation, perception-planning coupling, and embodied AI.
tldr: This survey reviews learning-based motion planning in dynamic environments, categorizing methods by how learning participates in the planning pipeline and covering applications in autonomous driving, service robotics, crowd navigation, and multi-robot systems.
tldr_zh: 本调查综述了动态环境中基于学习的运动规划，根据学习在规划流程中的参与方式对方法进行分类，涵盖自动驾驶、服务机器人、人群导航和多机器人系统等应用。
summary_zh: 动态环境中的运动规划是机器人学中的一个基础问题，旨在存在移动障碍物、不确定预测以及多智能体交互的情况下生成安全且高效的路径、轨迹或控制动作。它在自动驾驶、服务机器人、仓库物流、人机协作、人群导航及多机器人系统中具有广泛应用。本综述主要回顾了2015年至2025年间发表的代表性工作，重点探讨近年来基于学习的进展如何扩展、补充或与传统规划基础相互作用。我们首先回顾经典规划方法，将其作为学习扩展的算法基础与参考框架。随后提出一种基于学习角色的分类法，根据学习参与规划流程的方式对现有方法进行分类，包括直接策略学习、学习增强型经典规划、混合规划以及训练增强方法。针对每个类别，我们总结了主要问题设定、代表性算法、核心思想、集成机制、优势与局限性。进一步分析了观测表征、预测不确定性、交互建模、规划器集成、安全约束及训练策略如何塑造动态环境中基于学习的运动规划。最后，探讨了开放挑战与未来方向，包括仿真到现实的差距、安全可认证规划、密集人群导航、感知-规划耦合以及具身人工智能。

title: Embodied Passive Aeroacoustic Perception Enables Relative Sensing and Pursuit Between Aerial Robots
summary: Aerial robots generate structured aeroacoustic fields during flight, yet these signals have been underexplored as a source of onboard relative perception, particularly under the strong ego-acoustic interference generated during simultaneous flight in various outdoor conditions. We introduce embodied passive aeroacoustic perception, a sensing paradigm in which an aerial robot infers actionable relative-state information from the naturally generated sound of flight while operating within its own evolving aeroacoustic field. We present SonicFly, a passive aeroacoustic perception framework that enables one unmanned aerial vehicle to estimate and follow another using only the leader's intrinsic flight sound, without active acoustic signaling, inter-robot communication, GPS sharing, or external sensing infrastructure. The system uses a lightweight four-microphone array, rotorcraft-informed acoustic representations, a neural bearing-range estimator, and confidence-gated filtering for closed-loop flight. Through acoustic characterization, onboard localization, and outdoor pursuit experiments, we show that multirotor aeroacoustic signals contain sufficient information to support relative perception despite strong ego-acoustic interference, environmental variability, and changing flight geometry. During acoustic-only pursuit, SonicFly achieved a mean distance-maintenance error of 1.34 m across diverse outdoor trajectories and operating conditions. Analysis of the acoustic channel reveals design principles governing embodied passive aeroacoustic perception, including the roles of harmonic structure, spectral separability, and spatial acoustic cues in determining observability. Our results establish the feasibility of embodied passive aeroacoustic perception for aerial robots and suggest that naturally generated behavioral signals can serve as information for robotic perception and coordination.
tldr: This paper introduces SonicFly, a passive aeroacoustic perception framework that enables an aerial robot to estimate and pursue another using only the leader's flight sound, without active signaling or external infrastructure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SonicFly，一种被动气动声学感知框架，使空中机器人仅通过领航者的飞行声音就能估计并追踪另一机器人，无需主动信号或外部基础设施。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
飞行机器人在飞行过程中会产生结构化的气动声场，然而这些信号作为机载相对感知的来源尚未得到充分探索，尤其是在多种室外条件下同时飞行时产生强烈自噪声干扰的场景下。我们提出“具身被动气动声学感知”这一感知范式：飞行机器人在其自身动态变化的气动声场中运行时，能从自然产生的飞行声音中推断出可操作的相对状态信息。我们介绍了SonicFly——一种被动气动声学感知框架，使一架无人机能够仅利用另一架无人机固有的飞行声音进行估计与跟随，无需主动声学信号、机器人间通信、GPS共享或外部感知基础设施。该系统采用轻量化四麦克风阵列、基于旋翼飞行器特性的声学表征、神经方位-距离估计器以及用于闭环飞行的置信门控滤波。通过声学特性分析、机载定位及室外追踪实验，我们证明：尽管存在强烈的自噪声干扰、环境变化及飞行几何构型变动，多旋翼气动声学信号仍包含足以支撑相对感知的信息。在仅依赖声学信号的追踪任务中，SonicFly在多种室外轨迹与运行条件下实现了平均距离保持误差1.34米。对声学通道的分析揭示了支配具身被动气动声学感知的设计原理，包括谐波结构、频谱可分性及空间声学线索在决定可观测性中的作用。我们的研究结果确立了具身被动气动声学感知在飞行机器人中的可行性，并表明自然生成的行为信号可作为机器人感知与协调的信息来源。

title: When Prompts Control Robots: Prompt Injection Attacks in Multi-Agent Robotic Systems
summary: Large language models are increasingly integrated into autonomous robotic systems for task planning and control, but this integration exposes them to prompt injection attacks that can lead to unsafe decisions and physical harm. Multi-agent settings increase the risks through cross-agent contamination and broader attack surfaces. In this paper, we evaluate prompt injection attacks against an LLM-based multi-agent robotic system, considering both direct injections into task instructions and indirect injections through perception modules. In our experiments across varying attack-goal complexities and injection strategies in both single-agent and multi-agent settings, we show that prompt injection can induce adversarial actions while reducing task completion. We find that attacks can propagate from one agent to others through shared prompt structures, with impacts varying depending on prompt composition and the targeted agent. We further analyze how architectural changes affect LLM queries and, consequently, the attack success. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study that systematically investigates prompt injection attacks in a multi-agent LLM-based robotic system.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates prompt injection attacks against LLM-based multi-agent robotic systems, demonstrating that attacks can propagate across agents and induce adversarial actions while reducing task completion.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了针对基于LLM的多智能体机器人系统的提示注入攻击，展示了攻击可在智能体间传播并诱导对抗性行动，同时降低任务完成率。

title: StochSIPP: Safe Interval Path Planning in Stochastic Dynamic Environments
summary: Safe navigation under uncertain time-dependent blockage requires anticipating observations before committing to motion. We present StochSIPP, an exact contingent planner for temporal roadmaps with uncertain edge and vertex statuses revealed locally during execution. StochSIPP uses SIPP to generate certified-safe macro-actions that terminate at the next observation or the goal, and bounded AND/OR search over a cached action--observation graph to select actions for every reachable observation outcome. Optimistic and robust SIPP relaxations provide admissible lower and upper bounds for bounded AND/OR search. When every interval declared deterministically safe is truly safe, sensing is exact, and execution follows the planned timing, the resulting policy is provably collision-free. With correct independent probabilities and complete action and outcome generation, it minimizes expected arrival time within the roadmap and horizon. Experiments on controlled roadmap instances show that StochSIPP preserves the observed success of safe fixed-path baselines while reducing arrival time, and solves gated scenarios in which conservative fixed-path planners return no plan. A scalability study further reveals rapid growth as the number of simultaneously observed uncertain statuses increases.
tldr: StochSIPP is an exact contingent planner for safe navigation under stochastic dynamic obstacles, using macro-actions and AND/OR search to minimize expected arrival time while guaranteeing collision-free execution.
tldr_zh: StochSIPP是一种在随机动态环境下进行安全导航的精确应急规划器，通过宏动作和AND/OR搜索最小化预期到达时间，同时保证无碰撞执行。

title: OmniAI: A Surface-Adaptive Aerial Projection Interface for Human--Drone Interaction
summary: Drones in human environments often lack spatially grounded in- terfaces for situated communication. We present OmniAI, an em- bodied aerial agent that supports surface-adaptive interaction by switching projection between an onboard screen and nearby en- vironmental surfaces. A servo-actuated MEMS laser projector renders text-and-image responses from a web-augmented LLM pipeline. Projection surfaces are detected online using RGB-D sensing and RANSAC plane fitting, without pre-mapped geometry. OmniAI provides functionally equivalent voice and gesture con- trol for both drone motion and projected content. By combining speech, mid-air gestures, adaptive projection, and aerial mobility, OmniAI demonstrates a mobile spatial AR interface for context- aware human-drone interaction.
tldr: OmniAI is an embodied aerial agent (drone) that uses adaptive projection onto environmental surfaces combined with voice/gesture control and an LLM pipeline to enable spatially grounded human-drone interaction.
tldr_zh: OmniAI 是一种具身空中代理（无人机），通过将投影自适应地切换到环境表面，结合语音/手势控制和 LLM 流水线，实现空间接地的人机交互。

title: Assistant Placement Aria: A Benchmark for Egocentric Placement Assistance
summary: Human assistance in robotics spans around several tasks such as navigation, object manipulation, and placement, where a key challenge is selecting target destinations that align with human intentions or preferences. We focus on this challenge in the context of Virtual Placement (VP), the task of identifying all plausible target locations given scene context and human-centric constraints. This differs from traditional placement tasks that typically focus on a single, predefined target location. The VP problem is complex, as it requires both global and local reasoning about the scene's geometry, semantics, and plausibility. To address this gap, we introduce {\bf Assistant Placement Aria}, the first benchmark to explore diverse aspects of VP, including global, local, and human-centric constraints. It contains both synthetic and real indoor scenes annotated for three tasks: (i)~2D Panel Placement, (ii)~Sitting Suggestion, and (iii)~TV Placement. Each scene includes 2D images, a 3D point cloud, and a textual description of the objects within the scene. By contributing this benchmark, we aim to encourage further research in this underexplored and challenging field that is critically dependent on relevant data. We also evaluate several foundation models for object detection and segmentation on our benchmark.
tldr: Introduces Assistant Placement Aria, the first benchmark for Virtual Placement in egocentric scenes, including synthetic and real data for three placement tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了Assistant Placement Aria，这是首个针对自我中心场景中虚拟放置任务的基准，包含合成和真实数据，涵盖三项放置任务。

title: Belief-Space Perception Routing under Coupled Sensor Faults and Compute Contention
summary: A robot that has to see and react on a fixed clock runs into two problems at once. Its cameras degrade in rain, mud, fog, and darkness. And the single onboard processor it runs on is shared with planning and control, so the compute left over for perception moves around from second to second. Most systems model the two separately. We present a perception router that tracks probabilistic estimates of sensor-fault state and compute- contention state, couples them with a noisy-OR term, and uses the coupled estimate to pick one of four detector configurations (YOLO11x/n at 1280 or 640 px) so that the frame finishes before its deadline. Where the two stressors co-occur, the coupled policy cuts the deadline-miss rate by 1.1 to 9.4 percentage points against a policy that treats them independently. The interval excludes zero in five of six conditions, the pooled effect over 10 sequences and 6 conditions has sign-test p = 0.001, and every uncoupled control and the fault-free trajectory sit at exactly 0.0 pp. Routing costs tens of microseconds per frame. We then asked whether the coupling the method exploits arises on its own. Across eight real RADIATE adverse-weather sequences and three workload proxies independent of the fault signal, after Benjamini-Hochberg correction and a replication run, none of 24 tests found it. We report that null and scope the routing result as a proof of mechanism. Whether such coupling occurs in the field is still open, and the released evaluation pipeline lets a deployment settle it on its own traces.
tldr: This paper proposes a belief-space perception router that tracks and couples probabilistic estimates of sensor faults and compute contention, using a noisy-OR term to select detector configurations and reduce deadline-miss rates in robotic perception.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种信念空间感知路由方法，通过跟踪并耦合传感器故障与计算争用的概率估计，利用噪-OR项选择检测器配置，以降低机器人感知中的截止时间错过率。

title: RF-HOI: Recognize Human-Object Interaction with Radio Frequency Signals
summary: Recognizing Human-Object Interactions (HOI) is essential for intelligent systems, underpinning applications in virtual and augmented reality, embodied AI, and assistive robotics. However, vision-based HOI methods face challenges in privacy concerns and poor light conditions. In this work, we introduce RF-HOI, the first framework that only uses radio frequency (RF) signals for HOI recognition. A key challenge of RF-HOI is that single-modality RF sensing is insufficient to recognize both actions and the objects being interacted with. RF-HOI addresses this through a novel modality fusion that combines mmWave radar and RFID, enabling simultaneous action recognition and target identification. Another challenge is limited training data across diverse setups, which impairs the generalizability of the recognition model. To overcome this, we develop a simulator that synthesizes multimodal RF data for diverse HOIs at scale, allowing us to fine-tune with only a small amount of real-world data. Experiment results show that RF-HOI outperforms all baselines, approaching vision model performance, and that our diverse synthetic training data can significantly boost our system's performance on real-world scenarios. These results highlight the potential of multimodal RF sensing for robust and privacy-preserving HOI recognition as well as the effectiveness of our RF data synthesis.
tldr: RF-HOI proposes the first framework using only radio frequency signals (mmWave radar + RFID) for privacy-preserving Human-Object Interaction recognition, and introduces a simulator to generate synthetic multimodal RF training data.
tldr_zh: RF-HOI 提出了首个仅使用射频信号（毫米波雷达+RFID）进行人-物交互识别的框架，并引入模拟器生成合成多模态RF训练数据。

title: Localization in Spatiotemporal Fields via Environmental PDEs
summary: This paper proposes a localization framework that uses spatiotemporal fields governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) as localization signatures. Two PDE classes are considered: the shallow water equations, which describe free-surface flows in coastal and riverine environments, and the advection-diffusion equation, which models the transport and mixing of scalar quantities such as temperature, salinity, and dissolved oxygen. A numerical PDE solver provides predicted fields over the domain, and multiple field channels are fused as multimodal measurements to improve localization accuracy. We formulate the problem within a Rao-Blackwellized particle filter (RBPF) that partitions the vehicle state into a nonlinear component sampled by particles and a linear sensor bias component tracked analytically via per-particle Kalman filters. This factorization reduces the required number of particles compared to a standard particle filter while accounting for realistic sensor drift. Simulation studies on both PDE scenarios show that the RBPF consistently outperforms a standard particle filter in terms of final position error and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) across varying particle counts. Field experiments with an autonomous surface vehicle measuring salinity, temperature, and dissolved oxygen validate that PDE-governed environmental fields provide sufficient spatial variability for practical localization. Related experimental videos are available at https://localization-environmental-pdes.github.io/.
tldr: This paper proposes a localization framework using PDE-governed spatiotemporal fields (e.g., shallow water and advection-diffusion equations) as signatures, combined with a Rao-Blackwellized particle filter to fuse multimodal field measurements for vehicle localization, validated in simulation and field experiments with an autonomous surface vehicle.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种利用偏微分方程控制的时空场作为位置指纹的定位框架，结合 Rao-Blackwellized 粒子滤波融合多模态场测量来实现车辆定位，并通过仿真和自主水面船实地实验验证。

title: bFaaaP: An Inclusive, Head-Angle Piano-Pedal Interaction that Quantitatively Reproduces a Pianist's Intended Pedalling -- Foot-Free, for Acoustic and Electronic Pianos
summary: Expressive piano performance depends on the sustain (damper) pedal, operated by foot, excluding players who cannot readily use their feet: wheelchair users and others with lower-limb impairments, small children, and some elderly or disabled players. We present bFaaaP (barrier-Free assist as a Pedal), an inclusive, foot-free interaction that operates the pedal from the angle of the player's head: a smartphone tracks head pose with on-device augmented-reality (AR) face tracking and streams a compact command over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to a pedal device. Supported by patent examination, our central claim is not the head-to-pedal architecture (anticipated by prior art) but a quantitative, user-tunable control law -- the patentable "key" to a natural, expressive result: the player presets a small angular dead-zone (offset 3-10 degrees) and a multiplier (10-50), which together fix a secondary, pre-adjustable response speed that reproduces the pianist's intended pedalling. An engineering trick decouples the fast AR sampling from the slower BLE rate. Two co-equal realizations share one controller: a non-destructive robotic actuator for acoustic pianos (Pro), anchored by a pneumatic "airback" (our coined term for an inflatable air-braced anchor) that absorbs the reaction force without modifying the instrument; and an electronic sustain switch for digital pianos (Switch). In a human-subject Auxiliary Pedal Effect Evaluation (APEE) with 15 participants, bFaaaP significantly increased sustained-tone energy (p<0.01) and was statistically indistinguishable from a player's own foot (p>0.05), with no significant difference across classes; one participant with a leg disability and a tracheostomy performed successfully. With nothing worn on the face and fast setup, bFaaaP has run in formal public concerts (2018-2025). We release the full hardware and software as open source.
tldr: bFaaaP is a foot-free piano pedal interface using head-angle tracking and a tunable control law to reproduce intended pedalling, validated with 15 subjects including one with a leg disability.
tldr_zh: bFaaaP 是一种免脚的钢琴踏板交互方式，通过头部角度追踪和可调控制律再现演奏者的踏板意图，经15名受试者验证。

title: From Digital to Physical Reservoir Computing: Co-Optimizing Soft Robotic Reservoirs via Dynamics Matching
summary: Soft robotic substrates are promising for Physical Reservoir Computing (PRC) because their compliant nonlinear dynamics can provide temporal memory, high-dimensional state transformations, and efficient inference. However, physical reservoirs are often adopted as-is rather than pretrained or co-optimized, potentially limiting soft robotic PRC performance relative to digital reservoirs. We investigate whether a physical reservoir can instead be pretrained against high-performing digital reference dynamics. Our formulation jointly optimizes physical parameters, a diffeomorphic physical-reference state map, and feedforward-feedback control using a differentiable physical model and an acceleration-level equation-error objective that avoids temporal integration. As a proof of concept, we instantiate the formulation with simulated soft robots, a Random Oscillators Network (RON) reference, and parallel multi-start gradient descent. We evaluate the optimized reservoirs on classification (sMNIST and ADIAC) and forecasting (Mackey-Glass and Lorenz96) tasks across four reservoir dimensions. Compared with unoptimized soft robot reservoirs, the optimized reservoirs achieve a mean relative improvement of 33.7% across all tasks and datasets, while remaining close to the digital reference. These results demonstrate the feasibility of dynamics-level co-optimization for the simulated soft robotic reservoirs considered here.
tldr: This paper proposes a method to co-optimize soft robotic reservoirs against a digital reference reservoir via dynamics matching, achieving improved performance on classification and forecasting tasks while maintaining physical plausibility.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过动力学匹配联合优化软体机器人储层与数字参考储层的方法，在分类和预测任务上取得了性能提升，同时保持了物理可行性。

title: LOCUS-DT: Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins
summary: Accurate indoor localization is essential for emerging applications in robotic navigation and search and rescue. While classical methods typically focus on single-point estimates, complex indoor environments with heavy blockage and multipath propagation often lead to multimodal likelihood surfaces where a single estimate is insufficient.
